title: Teachers’ public parade and grievances at Beseke ceremonial ground
scope: Local public parade; scope beyond reported Douala event unknown
threshold_50_evidence: CNA describes teachers parading publicly, but no count or lower-bound estimate; >=50 unknown.

occurrence.summary: CNA body reports a teachers' public parade before the Littoral governor and education delegates.

date.summary: Occurred during World Teachers' Day in October; story published 6 Oct but does not establish exact event day. October month precision retained.

demands.summary: Grievances included unpaid government debts, private-sector wages, integration files and ministry corruption.

state_target.summary: Some grievances explicitly directed at government; other grievances concerned private-school proprietors.

state_response.summary: Governor made statements about government measures and settled marking/invigilation debt; whether this meets response coding requires review.

notes: The article supports occurrence and grievances but not ≥50. Although a separate programme search result listed 5 Oct, it is only an announced schedule and does not prove event execution date. Event day therefore remains unknown at month precision; the parade may combine ceremony and grievances.
open_questions: Exact date and ≥50 count; share of event that was state-directed protest vs commemorative program; event-specific government response classification.

title: Teachers gather in Bamenda during World Teachers’ Day-related action
scope: Local event; no broader organization established
threshold_50_evidence: Search-only snippet says teachers gathered; no simultaneous attendance number. >=50 not established.

occurrence.summary: Search result says teachers gathered in Bamenda on 5 Oct; body could not be retrieved due anti-bot challenge.

date.summary: 5 October date appears only in search result.

location.summary: Bamenda / North-West Region in search result.

demands.summary: Snippet mentions calls for teacher rights, safe learning and increased education funding.

state_target.summary: Snippet refers to calls on stakeholders; government target is not verified.

notes: Exact source body was blocked by anti-bot challenge; no retry. Search-only evidence supports discovery but not coding; candidate kept separate from Douala event.
open_questions: Body-access limitation; exact form and occurrence; simultaneous attendance; state target; relation, if any, to Douala commemoration.

title: Maumu women’s protest outside South-West Gendarmerie headquarters
organizer: Women from Maumu; organizer not identified
threshold_50_evidence: Main report gives no count. Search-only secondary result says 'dozens', which does not establish >=50.

occurrence.summary: MMI reports women from Maumu sat on the road outside Gendarmerie headquarters.

demands.summary: Release of detained children/relatives, investigation and end to arbitrary detentions.

threshold_50.summary: No numeric or clear threshold evidence; independent search-only 'dozens' remains below/ambiguous.

state_target.summary: Demand directed to state security authorities.

state_response.summary: Buea DO spoke to protesters and promised an investigation; follow-up reports protest-linked arrests but identities/classification are unclear.

notes: Keep reported journalist abuse separate from protester violence. Follow-up arrest totals are not turnout evidence and include arrests outside the demonstration.
open_questions: Simultaneous participant count; organizer; exact arrest identities and relation; end of gathering; response beyond DO assurance.

title: Phytosanitary companies’ strike call over Port of Douala fee
scope: Strike call affecting port phytosanitary services; public gathering not shown
threshold_50_evidence: No public gathering or simultaneous crowd evidence in official account.

occurrence.summary: CNCC reports a strike call launched 14 Oct.

date.summary: Strike call date 14 Oct; daily action dates/end unknown.

demands.summary: Opposition to a new 700 CFA-franc per tonne or cubic metre fee imposed by port authority.

threshold_50.summary: No evidence of a public gathering or simultaneous 50 participants.

state_target.summary: Fee attributed to Port of Douala; whether public policy demand vs business dispute requires review.

notes: Strike call is not itself evidence of a public gathering. November consultation and lifting recommendation are not evidence of continuous daily activity.
open_questions: Whether workers took to a public forum/street; attendance; policy authority and state target; dates of active action and end.

title: Public-university teachers’ class stoppage over research premium
scope: Reported strike/stoppage across public higher-education sector; no physical gathering established
organizer: Syndicat National des Enseignants du Supérieur (SYNES)
threshold_50_evidence: Article reports class stoppage, not a public gathering; no participant count.

occurrence.summary: Journal du Cameroun reports public-sector higher-education teachers had been on strike and stopping classes.

date.summary: Since Wednesday 16 October, as reported in body.

location.summary: Public university campuses, exact sites unspecified.

demands.summary: Complete payment of third tranche of research-modernization premium; government deadline 15 October.

threshold_50.summary: No physical assembly or simultaneous count reported.

notes: Class stoppage/strike alone does not show a qualifying public gathering. No crowd or public demonstration is described in opened body.
open_questions: Whether any rally/public gathering occurred; simultaneous count; campus list; continuity/end; further independent reporting.
